exercises.name: Cable Straight Bar Triceps Pushdown
exercises.notes: Superset with cable curl: perform one pushdown set, then one curl set, then rest about 75 seconds. Repeat for 3 rounds. When all 3 sets hit 12 reps, add 5 lb next time. Repeat on the same three training days each week; aim for about 30 minutes per session.

exercises.name: Cable Straight Bar Biceps Curl
exercises.notes: Superset with pushdown: perform after each pushdown set, then rest about 75 seconds. When all 3 sets hit 12 reps, add 5 lb next time. Repeat on the same three training days each week; aim for about 30 minutes per session.
